{{Quote|The Imps are doing more than enough damage on their own, but they went extra mile and hired Mandalorian mercenaries too.|Rond Berrin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Rond Berrin''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] mercenaries were hired by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[3642 BBY]] to disable the Balmorran resistance's sensors and set up camp around them, Berrin - stationed at [[Moraine Outpost]] - tasked a Republic citizen to repair the sensors.
